verdict.rationale: Groq documents a Batch API for submitting thousands of API requests as one asynchronous job. It costs 50% less, does not count against standard rate limits, and runs within a 24-hour to 7-day window. Flex processing adds 10x higher rate limits for high-throughput workloads. Both features require a paid tier. Missing for 10: documentation of how batch jobs are submitted, monitored and cancelled, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that batch processing works as described.
